newsitem.title: JAPAN: JSF extended trading hours on JGB demand.
newsitem.headline: JSF extended trading hours on JGB demand.

text.p: A major broker in the Japanese government bonds repo market, Japan Securities Finance Co Ltd (JSF) extended trading hours on Friday, an official said.
The special action was needed because of strong demand for cash JGBs suitable for delivery against September JGB futures, the official said.
Normal trading hour of the company is from 8.45 a.m. (2345 GMT) to 3.40 p.m. (0640 GMT), the official said.
The hours were extended until 6 p.m. (0900 GMT).
The repo rates of the 161st 10-year cash JGBs and the 163rd 10-year JGBs, the cheapest JGBs for delivery against the September, have soared in recent weeks.
The repo rate for the 161st JGBs was 6.08 percent and that of the 163rd was 4.08 percent.
But some traders said the 161st JGBs' repo rate covering a period beyond the end of September hit a massive 30 percent in the offshore market.
